placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
The Downs give Bristol families a large open landscape to enjoy without an admission charge. A short walk, a picnic or an informal game can be enough to fill a happy afternoon.

Our family idea: bring a soft ball and choose a space well away from roads and other activities. Take turns inventing a simple game, then pack everything away for a short wander.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families wanting open space and a flexible outdoor plan.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Open grassland and walking paths; check the council visitor information for facilities.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Observe parking restrictions around the Downs or use public transport.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Roads cross and border the area. Keep games away from traffic and stay well back from Avon Gorge edges.
